data.name: IDUN Rogue
data.detailed_description:
IDUN Rogue is a third-person shooter where you create unique roguelike builds for you and your army to fight thousands of enemies, swarms large enough to scale walls, on a fully destructible and simulated battlefield.

MASSIVE SWARMS & FULLY DESTRUCTIBLE BATTLEFIELDS

Prepare to engage enemy counts beyond belief on terrain that permanently changes as the battle rages on. Leave behind a cratered, scorched wasteland by the time you reach extraction.

  • Thousands of Enemies: Face a swarm so big that it can scale walls just by sheer numbers to reach its target.

  • Fully Destructible Terrain: Explosions deform the ground in real time and change the battlefield forever.

  • Dynamic Fluid Physics: Water flows dynamically across the landscape, reacting to the changing terrain.

  • Destructible Environment: Rocks, foliage, trees, and environmental structures are all fully destructible.

ROGUELIKE BUILDS FOR YOU AND YOUR ARMY

Command the battlefield in high-intensity third-person 3D combat where survival hinges on creating absurd roguelike synergies and utilizing the full power of your army.

  • You Are Not Alone: Request immediate orbital support during missions, including heavily armored mechs, deployable turrets, drones, soldiers, and heavy artillery barrages.

  • Upgrade Everything: Add new assets to your army and your arsenal, and equip it all with roguelike items into screen-clearing builds. Turn your standard Minigun Turret into a homing projectile spewing machine that triggers chain-lightning on kill while setting everything on fire.

DYNAMIC RAIDS, BOUNTIES, & BASE UPGRADES

The Falcon is your retrofitted home and mobile strike center. Pick a Raid on the ship’s globe, play short linked missions while stacking run‑long upgrades, and spend your earnings to permanently upgrade the Falcon.

  • Multi-Stage Raids: Raids consist of series of short missions. Maintain and stack your roguelike upgrades across the entire duration of a Raid until you reach final extraction.

  • Tactical Route Selection: Navigate the Raid map after each mission to choose your next mission. Balance the challenge with the rewards you need.

  • Retrofit Your Base: Use the reward acquired from completed raids to upgrade The Falcon, unlock new features and customize it to your liking.

ROGUE MERCENARIES

In the orbit around a gas giant lies Idun, a moon rich with Epli but unfit for survival. With the Executoriat’s armada years away, outer‑rim mercenaries risk everything to claim imperial bounties.

  • Return to Idun: Continue the saga on the moon of Idun. Join the veteran crew from the original survival campaign as they navigate life as rogue mercenaries in the outer rim.

  • Executoriat Bounties: In preparation for their arrival, The Executoriat posts lucrative bounties to secure Epli deposits and strategic sites on Idun, drawing your crew into mercenary work.

  • The Start of Revolt: As you help the people of the outer rim, the wealth and firepower you acquire may no longer be just for survival. This might be the exact spark needed to fuel a resistance on the frontier...

data.short_description: IDUN Rogue redefines roguelite shooters by putting an entire upgradeable army at your command. Survive against thousands of enemies physically piling up to eat you and your army on a fully destructible battlefield!
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
